title: Why did it fail? Reference, screen and diff, side by side
description:
A test step failed. VirtualPyTest does not just say so: it shows the reference the screen was expected to match, the frame the device actually showed, and the pixels that differ, so anyone can see why in one look.

What you see:
1. The check: a node in the navigation tree verifies two things, an element and an image. The image check carries its reference, the part of the screen it expects to see.
2. The run: a normal goto crosses that node and fails at the image check. The failure is on purpose here: the reference was taken on another screen.
3. The test report: the run failed at step 2. Open the step: the image check scored 65 %, and the comparison is one click away.
4. The comparison: 65 % match against 80 % required, with the first, best and last frame it checked.
5. Side by side: what the screen showed, what the reference expected, and a pixel-diff overlay of what changed.
